task.goal: A job scheduler accepts durations such as 250ms, 2s, 3m, and 1h and stores integer milliseconds. The parser matches the s suffix inside ms and accepts malformed trailing text. Fix parse_duration(value) in duration.py, rejecting negative or malformed values, then run visible tests and validate.

result.text: I'll start by finding and reading the parser.The visible tests pass; my strictness check caught one real hole — `$` allows a trailing newline. Tightening to `\Z`.Now recording kernel validation for the requirements.The kernel keeps only the latest validation live, so I'll consolidate into one requirement that covers both checks.Validations keep superseding one another; let me refresh all three required requirements in a single batch and re-derive completion.
